Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1204
Claimant:
Ashley Butler
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
April 8, 2025
Claimant reported a low-speed collision while backing out of a space in a parking lot and said the other vehicle struck
the rear quarter panel of their car. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and provided initial contact details
voluntarily.
May 31, 2025
Reviewed the police report and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the incident, as the
responding officer and two witnesses described the same sequence of events.
June 8, 2025
Obtained photos from the scene and from the other driver showing contact damage consistent with the described
impact. The damage to the rear quarter panel and bumper is mostly in line with a collision of this type.
June 25, 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the accident happened as the claimant described it and that the vehicles
made contact in the lot.
June 28, 2025
Claimant reports pain in the right shoulder following the impact and has started seeing a physician. The reported
injury is plausible for a collision of this kind.
July 31, 2025
Checked prior claims and vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the start of the current coverage period.
August 9, 2025
Confirmed no earlier injury to the same shoulder area is on file. Claimant described no prior treatment for that body
part.
August 16, 2025
Claimant told the same account of the incident in each conversation so far, including the location, the direction of
travel, and the sequence of contact.
September 12, 2025
Received treatment records showing the claimant attended physical therapy on a usual schedule. Symptoms have
improved steadily, and the treatment plan is tapering off as recovery progresses.
September 18, 2025
Confirmed the driver of the vehicle lievs with the policyholder and qualifies as a covered household member under
the policy.
September 21, 2025
Reviewed the medical notes with the claimant's permission. Progress is consistent with the expected recovery course
for this type of soft tissue shoulder injury, and no complications have been recorded.
October 20, 2025
Claim is progressing normally. Remaining items are the final medical bill and the repair estimate. Will follow up once
both are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
